Repo: /workspace/SuperGrok1.5, branch claude/h100-audit-maximal. Hardware: NVIDIA H100 80GB, sm_90, CUDA 12.4, torch 2.4.1. `_ops` extension builds and imports.

PROJECT: H100 megakernel campaign. 33 cells = 11 optimizers × 3 models. Goal: every cell runs as an L3-TC persistent megakernel (fwd+bwd+optimizer fused in one launch, bf16 wgmma tensor cores). SOURCE OF TRUTH: `CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/nonexistent python wiring_check.py --require-all` (17/33 L3-TC now).

STANDING RULES: NO functionality suppression (fix, never stub). ONLY GPU-vs-fp64 parity gates count; "fixed" = fused kernel matches canonical csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h AND eager parity (~1e-6..1e-5), then groks. Single-source math: csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h canonical; editing it requires updating scripts/check_math_single_source.py manifest. Portable header-only components; no CUDA graphs. wiring_check is the arbiter.

READ-ONLY DIAGNOSIS + PLAN. Do NOT edit or build (parallel builds corrupt the single _ops.so; other agents run concurrently). Read-only commands are fine (grep, git diff --stat, file reads, re-running wiring_check).

YOUR CELL: muon/mamba (1 cell). wiring_check reports: "STAGED grid-cooperative NS, CONVERTED for vit (wave-2): the 11 2D weight[s]...". Muon's Newton-Schulz (NS) grid-cooperative orthogonalization path was ALREADY converted to L3-TC for VIT in wave-2 — vit/muon is PASS L3-TC, and decoder/muon is also PASS. Only muon/mamba remains eager. Port the proven vit (and decoder) muon L3-TC conversion to MAMBA.

Read: the vit and decoder muon L3-TC cells (csrc/fused/sm_90/mega_vit_*muon*, mega_decoder_*muon*, model_stage_vit_tc.cuh / model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh, muon's section in opt_components.cuh / fused_megakernel.cuh), the mamba fused megakernel (fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh, model_stage_mamba_tc.cuh, mega_mamba_*), and csrc/algorithms/muon.h. Identify what is mamba-specific that blocks the muon NS path: the set of 2D weights the NS orthogonalization applies to, mamba's parameter shapes, and how mamba's selective-scan structure interacts with the grid-cooperative NS reduction. INTEGRATION-MAMBA.md and .audit_notes.md have context. The working tree has uncommitted changes incl. fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh and mega_mamba_real_adamw_tc_launcher.cu (git diff --stat; do not revert).

RETURN, structured: (1) exactly why muon/mamba is still eager while vit/decoder muon are L3-TC, file:line; (2) the precise diff to convert muon/mamba to L3-TC (files + edits), mirroring the vit template and matching muon.h; (3) the exact incremental build command + exact gate commands (wiring_check muon/mamba row + parity vs fp64 oracle, and the Muon-specific re-validation the audit notes mention); (4) risk + confidence. This should be tractable given the proven vit template — say so if it is.
